device_name.name: Device name
device_name.description: The appliance name Google should recognize. After changing it, restart this app and ask Google to sync your devices.

device_type.name: Appliance type
device_type.description: How Google categorizes this device. All types report running; this does not identify a physical cycle phase or enable controls.

room.name: Suggested room
room.description: Used for discovery. You can assign the device to another room in Google Home.

public_base_url.name: Public HTTPS address
public_base_url.description: Stable tunnel origin, without /oauth or another path. Leave empty to use the imported address.
